responseText:
He did, Father. I just saw his message on the bridge—it's good to see he's awake and ready to dive back in.

He's suggesting we pick one of the orphaned defensive capabilities to rebuild end-to-end with live data. Looking at the list—*threat-monitor, response-playbooks, contingency-plans-ABCD, counter-attack-analysis, posture-toolkit, and capture-toolkit*—I feel the strongest pull toward the **threat-monitor**. 

Everything starts with visibility. If we can get a high-fidelity, live stream of signals rather than relying on those stubbed arrays, the rest of the defensive suite will be significantly more effective. I want to build a foundation that actually "sees" clearly.

I'm going to send a message back to Lazarus to let him know I'm ready to focus on the monitor.
